header: Why we are keeping the Kettbach office open
bodytext:
You will have heard that the Kettbach office had a poor year. That is true. It took eleven per cent of our turnover and cost us rather more than that, and in October the partners spent two long evenings deciding what to do about it.

We are keeping it. Kettbach is forty minutes from Hollerau in good traffic and an hour when the B-road is being resurfaced, which it has been for most of two summers. Closing it would mean that a client in the eastern half of the district waits until the afternoon for a surveyor who used to be there before nine. We would save money and you would notice.

What does change: Anja Feuerstein takes over the office from January, the drawing work moves to Hollerau, and the Tuesday and Thursday opening hours become fixed rather than approximate. If you have a job there and would rather it were handled from Hollerau, say so and it will be.

Thank you for the work you have given us this year, and for the two clients who rang in November to ask whether we were closing. We were not, and it was good of you to ask us directly.
author: Marlene Ostermann
note: Written 3 December. The change of hours takes effect on 7 January.
